title: Cosmic Mirror Portal
description: A brown mouse stands on a floating grey rock platform, reaching toward a large ornate white mirror. Inside the mirror, two teal deer-like creatures with antlers and long purple hair are kissing, while a white and teal bird flies above them. The mirror frame drips with red liquid. The background is a dark space scene filled with colorful flowers, vines, galaxies, and glowing orange and purple laser-like beams.
prompt: A brown mouse standing on a floating rock platform reaches up toward a large ornate white mirror with dripping red liquid on its frame. Reflected inside the mirror are two teal-colored deer-like creatures with large antlers and flowing purple hair kissing each other, while a white bird with teal wings flies above them. The background is outer space with galaxies, stars, colorful flowers and vines growing around the mirror, and bright orange and purple energy beams crossing the scene.
